Docs / Stock Git compatibility

Stock Git compatibility

Conformance suite forkmesh-stock-git 1.0.0. Statuses were computed 2026-09-14 from 2 retained stock-Git runs: 39 of 39 support claims have a passing run from the last 30 days. Supported rows run with an unmodified Git executable (minimum 2.34.0); every retained JSON report records the exact Git and platform version.

A claim without a passing run is published as unverified, one whose newest passing run is older than 30 days as stale, and one with a failed retained run as failing. This page re-checks freshness against your clock. Download the published results or the source matrix.

Repository shape: A bare repository whose main branch has three commits: an SSH-signed commit adding a README, a 128 KiB binary payload, and a gitlink submodule at deps/fixture resolved through a relative URL, followed by two history commits. A lightweight tag points at the signed commit; receive and transfer fsck are enabled, and a read-only replica rejects every push.

Known limitations

HTTPS pushes need a credential and are not probed by this suite

Applies to
relay, mirror-failover
Expected result
A push to the stable HTTPS URL without a credential gets HTTP 401 push_unauthorized with a Basic challenge before ForkMesh reads the push body. With a credential, the relay checks that the account may write the repository and streams the push to one endpoint that accepts receive-pack; for a repository the core nodes host, that is the core that last took a push, else the first live core in rendezvous order. Read mirrors never take writes.
Reproduce
git push https://app.forkmesh.com/OWNER/REPOSITORY.git HEAD
Action
When Git asks, enter your ForkMesh account name or email and either your account password (when two-factor authentication is off) or the push credential from Settings, SSH keys, Push code over HTTPS. On the core nodes the default and protected branches only fast-forward, other branches may be force-pushed by accounts that may write them, new tags are allowed, and a push never deletes a branch.
Recovery
A refused push changes no remote ref or object. Check the account name and the password or credential, then retry the same push; HTTP 403 push_forbidden means the account may not push to this repository. The Git errors page lists every message.
Last tested
2026-10-24 · not applicable (source contract tests) · app/tests/test_git_http.py::test_receive_pack_fails_closed_without_consuming_request_body, app/tests/test_hosted_repositories.py::test_account_name_or_email_and_password_push

Repository-controlled server hooks are disabled

Applies to
direct, relay, mirror-failover
Expected result
Client-side hooks in a checkout run normally. Gateways set core.hooksPath to the null device so pushed repository configuration cannot execute code on a mirror.
Reproduce
git -C worktree commit -m 'exercise local hook'
Action
Keep developer hooks local; put shared required checks in reviewed ForkMesh Actions or another CI system.
Recovery
A rejected local hook leaves the index and remote unchanged; fix or intentionally bypass the local hook according to project policy.
Last tested
2026-08-20 · Git 2.47.3 · forkmesh-stock-git v1 hooks probe

A response cannot change mirrors mid-stream

Applies to
mirror-failover
Expected result
ForkMesh retries another eligible mirror only before response bytes are committed. An interrupted pack fails as a normal Git transport error.
Reproduce
git fetch --prune origin
Action
Retry the fetch; Git reuses valid local objects and ForkMesh may select another matching mirror for the new request.
Recovery
Run git fsck --full --strict if the client or disk reported corruption. Do not delete the existing clone before collecting diagnostics.
Last tested
2026-08-20 · Git 2.47.3 · forkmesh-stock-git v1 mirror-failover and integrity probes

Partial clone requires Git protocol v2

Applies to
direct, relay, mirror-failover
Expected result
A protocol-v0 filtered clone may receive the initial commits and trees, but its first lazy blob fetch is rejected as an unadvertised-object request so hidden ForkMesh objects remain inaccessible.
Reproduce
git -c protocol.version=0 clone --filter=blob:none --no-checkout '{clone_url}' worktree
Action
Use Git 2.34 or newer and retry with -c protocol.version=2, or omit --filter for a full clone.
Recovery
Remove the incomplete disposable clone, or keep it for diagnostics and clone into a new directory with protocol v2; no remote ref or object was changed.
Last tested
2026-08-20 · Git 2.47.3 · forkmesh-stock-git v1 protocol-v0 rejection and protocol-v2 partial-clone probes

Submodules are separate repositories

Applies to
direct, relay, mirror-failover
Expected result
The superproject clone succeeds, then Git names the exact submodule whose independent URL is unavailable or unauthorized.
Reproduce
git clone --recurse-submodules '{clone_url}' worktree
Action
Confirm every .gitmodules URL uses a published public HTTPS route or an SSH route your key may read, then run git submodule update --init --recursive.
Recovery
The superproject and any completed submodules remain valid; Git resumes the missing child without recloning successful repositories.
Last tested
2026-08-20 · Git 2.47.3 · forkmesh-stock-git v1 submodules probe

Third-party desktop UI certification is not complete

Applies to
direct, relay, mirror-failover
Expected result
GitHub Desktop, Sourcetree, and GitKraken are not release-supported rows until their exact application and bundled-Git versions produce a retained report.
Reproduce
python3 tools/git_conformance.py run --git /path/to/the/client/bundled/git --client-label 'CLIENT VERSION'
Action
Use a tested Git CLI or ForkMesh Qt build, or run the versioned probe with the desktop application's bundled Git before relying on it.
Recovery
The probe uses disposable repositories and makes no production write. Attach its JSON report when requesting a new supported row.

Run the suite

python3 tools/git_conformance.py validate
python3 tools/git_conformance.py render --check
python3 tools/git_conformance.py run --protocol-version 0 \
  --output artifacts/git-conformance-v0.json
python3 tools/git_conformance.py run --protocol-version 2 \
  --output artifacts/git-conformance-v2.json
python3 tools/git_conformance.py attest \
  artifacts/git-conformance-v0.json artifacts/git-conformance-v2.json
python3 tools/git_conformance.py gate

Use --git /path/to/git --client-label "client version" for a desktop application's bundled Git. Reports intentionally omit paths, URLs, repository contents, credentials, and client addresses.
